newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: IMPORT PRESSURE PUSHES ZIMBABWE DOLLAR LOWER.
newsitem.headline: IMPORT PRESSURE PUSHES ZIMBABWE DOLLAR LOWER.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against the key U.S. dollar at the close of Thursday's busy interbank trading session, foreign exchange dealers said.
"There were quite some big payments...we quoted as high as 10.8025/8225. The Reserve Bank had to come in a second time to bail out the dollar," a dealer said.
After the central bank intervention the local currency stabilised and closed at 10.7950/8150, but this was still weak compared to late Wednesday's 10.7800/8000.
On the crosses, however, it was quoted firmer against pound sterling at 17.9825/0240 from 18.0370/0810, while against the mark it edged up to 6.9415/9550 from 6.9440/9600.
The Zimbabwe dollar ended the day at 2.3100/3175 versus South Africa's rand, a slight gain over the previous day when it closed at 2.3000/3070.
